about.title: Layali Batroun.. Where the story begins
about.subtitle: And our flavors take you on a journey to the heart of Lebanon..
about.p1: Overlooking the authenticity of the ancient Batroun alleys, we transport you in a unique sensory experience that transcends the boundaries of place; from here, and from the heart of Kuwait, we open doors for you where the scent of jasmine meets the fragrance of authentic Lebanese cuisine.
about.p2: At Layali Batroun, we don't just serve food, we revive an ancient heritage and share its details with you in every dish. Welcome to your second home..
about.p3: Because hospitality is the essence of our identity, our team welcomes you with a warm Lebanese smile and a welcome from the heart. At Layali Batroun, we ensure an exceptional hospitality experience that makes every visit an unforgettable memory.

hospitality.title: Premium Hospitality
hospitality.desc: We care about the smallest details to give you a royal hospitality experience worthy of you and the authenticity of our traditions.

chef.title: Professional Chef
chef.desc: Our team of Lebanese chefs combine long experience and passion in every dish they serve.

ingredients.title: Fresh Ingredients
ingredients.desc: We select the finest fresh ingredients daily to guarantee an authentic and healthy Lebanese flavor in every bite.
